label: Escalation
description: A second kinetic surge. Reuters spikes to 0.85 kinetic. BBC drops to nearly zero on kinetic and humanitarian — and pivots to pure economic framing (0.90). AP stays in the middle.
divergence_note: Biggest kinetic spread in the dataset (0.85 gap between Reuters and BBC). The same escalation produces opposite editorial instincts: Reuters goes to war, BBC goes to markets.
